811: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤਿਨੑ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਲ ॥
The Lord's devoted ones are able to save the world from vice; if you would escape vice, hold to the hem of their robe.
ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਸੰਤਨ ਪਗ ਰਾਲ ॥੨॥
O God, give me too the gift of the dust of Your saints' feet. ॥2॥
ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
O Lord, I have no power of argument, no cleverness, and no labour of service to my credit.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੋਹ ਤੇ; ਕਾਟਹੁ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
My only plea at Your door: save me from wandering, fear and attachment, which lead into Death's net, and cut this net of Death. ॥3॥
O Source of compassion, Father able to protect, I pray to You.
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੧॥
Nanak, say: O Lord, be merciful, that dwelling in the holy congregation I may keep singing Your praises; Your holy congregation is the home of comforts. ॥4॥11॥41॥
ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ. ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ; ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
O Lord, whatever You wish to do, that You do; without Your prompting nothing can be done by beings.
ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ; ਜਮਦੂਤ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Seeing Your splendour, even Death's messengers let a being go. ॥1॥
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
O Lord, only by Your grace is ego removed and release from vice found,
ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O God of all powers, able to do all, full of all virtues, greatest Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿਆ; ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕੂਰੁ ॥
O Lord, searching and searching I have found that apart from Your Name all else is perishable.
ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੨॥
All the comfort of life is found in the holy congregation; O Lord, keep me there and fulfil this longing. ॥2॥
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ. ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ; ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਭ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
O Lord, to whatever task You set beings, to that they turn; so I have burnt away all my cleverness and wish to walk in Your will.
ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਮੑ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੀ ॥੩॥
O my Lord, Merciful to the meek, You are present everywhere; no one can defy You. ॥3॥
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
O Lord, we can beg everything from You alone; the fortunate one who begs receives it.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੨॥
O Lord, this is Nanak's prayer: be merciful, that singing Your praises I may gain spiritual life. ॥4॥12॥42॥
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਾਸਬੈ; ਕਲਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਨਸਨਾ ॥
Dwelling in the Guru's company, all sins are driven away.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਿਆ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਰਭਿ. ਨ ਗ੍ਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥
Through it one forms kinship with the Lord and is dyed in His love, and so does not fall into the round of birth and death. ॥1॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ; ਸੂਚੀ ਭਈ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Repeating the Lord's Name, the tongue becomes pure.
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Repeating the Name the Guru teaches, mind and body become pure. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਤ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਆ; ਮਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਹਸਨਾ ॥
In the Guru's refuge, tasting the relish of the Lord's Name, one is sated of greed for Maya; keeping that relish in the mind, one stays ever in bloom.
ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ; ਉਲਟਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
The light of true living shines in the intellect, and the heart-lotus, turned back from attachment to Maya, blossoms for ever. ॥2॥
ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸਭ ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
Repeating the Name in the Guru's refuge, the mind becomes cool, peace and contentment arise, and all craving for Maya is quenched.
ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੩॥
The running about in all ten directions for Maya ends, and one comes to dwell in the pure place of the Lord's feet. ॥3॥
The one whom the Protector has protected from vice has all wanderings burnt to ash.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੀ; ਪੇਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੩॥
Nanak: beholding the Guru, that person received the Lord's Name, which is all the treasures, and through it became happy for ever. ॥4॥13॥43॥
ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੈ; ਤਬ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
Carry water, wave the fan and grind corn in the house of the Lord's devotee; only then will you know bliss.
ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ; ਅਗਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Burn the world's kingdoms, lands and chieftainships in the fire; give up greed for them. ॥1॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਛੋਹਰਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
Fall at the feet of one who is a servant of the Guru's devoted ones.
ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ; ਤਿਨੑ ਛੋਡਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am ready to leave the company of wealthy kings and emperors, and would rather stay at the feet of the saints' servant. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਰੂਖਾ; ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
If dry bread is had from the house of the Guru's devoted ones, know it to be all the world's treasures.
ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਛਤੀਹ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ; ਤੇ ਬਿਖੂ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
If the thirty-six kinds of food are had in the house of one cut off from the Lord, know them to be like poison. ॥2॥
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਲੂਗਰਾ ਓਢਿ; ਨਗਨ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Even a torn blanket from the Lord's devotees, once worn, leaves no fear of being naked.
ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਰੇਸਮੀ; ਪਹਿਰਤ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੩॥
Even a silken robe of honour from one cut off from the Lord, once worn, loses one's honour. ॥3॥
ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਰਿਐ; ਅਧ ਵੀਚਹੁ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
Friendship kept with one cut off from the Lord does not last; it breaks halfway.
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ; ਇਤ ਊਤਹਿ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੪॥
The one who serves the Lord's devotees is spared quarrels and troubles in this world and the next. ॥4॥
ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ; ਆਪਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
But O Lord, what power have beings? Every deed of theirs comes from Your prompting; You Yourself have made this whole play.
ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੪॥੪੪॥
Nanak, pray: O Lord, be merciful, that beholding the Guru and dwelling in his company I may ever sing Your praises. ॥5॥14॥44॥
812: ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
O Lord, be merciful, that with my ears I may ever hear Your Name and keep singing the praise of You, the Master.
ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
Placing my hands and head at the feet of the saints, may I keep remembering Your Name. ॥1॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਇਹ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
O merciful Lord, be gracious, that I may receive from Your door this gift of the dust of the saints' feet; for me it is the nine treasures and the miraculous powers.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ; ਲੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O source of mercy, may I take the dust of Your saints' feet and ever apply it to my forehead. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਨੀਚ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੋਇ; ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
O Lord, be merciful, that becoming lower than the low, lowliest of all, I may humbly pray to the saints and call them to me,
ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ. ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
and giving up self-conceit, massage the saints' feet and stay absorbed in their company. ॥2॥
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ. ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ. ਨ ਧਾਵਉ ॥
O Lord, be merciful, that I may not forget Your Name with any breath, nor wander anywhere else, leaving the Guru's door.
ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ; ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
By Your grace may I meet the Guru whose sight makes life fruitful, and at his door remove pride and wipe out attachment. ॥3॥
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ; ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਉ ॥
O Lord, be merciful, that I may make truth, contentment, compassion and righteousness the adornment of my spiritual life.
ਸਫਲ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੫॥
Nanak, say: as a wedded bride is dear to her husband, so by His grace I may become fruitful in life and dear to my Lord. ॥4॥15॥45॥
ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨਾ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
The words of the Guru never fail; the Guru has openly proclaimed this to the whole world:
ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
the one who receives the company of the Guru meets the Sovereign Lord. ॥1॥
ਇਹ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
It is the Guru who creates within a being this faith in the Lord, that by repeating His Name one gains spiritual bliss.
ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਤਾ. ਸਭਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ; ਗੁਰੁ. ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All beings grow weary trying countless other ways, which do not succeed; it is the Guru who brings one to the Lord's feet. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਤਾ; ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾਇਆ ॥
The Guru teaches that the Lord keeps the honour of whoever comes to His refuge; of this there is no doubt.
ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਇ; ਅਉਸਰੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
So sow the Lord's Name in this human body, the field of deeds; this opportunity is very hard to come by. ॥2॥
ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
The Guru teaches that the Lord Himself knows every heart; all creation does as He prompts it.
ਪਤਿਤ. ਪੁਨੀਤ ਘਣੇ ਕਰੇ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
He makes countless sinners who come to His refuge pure of life; this is His age-old nature. ॥3॥
ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹੁ. ਮਾਨੁਖ ਜਨ; ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
O people, do not forget this, wandering in Maya:
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਸੀ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੬॥
Nanak, say: the one whom God Himself has robed in honour, He surely keeps that honour. ॥4॥16॥46॥
ਮਾਟੀ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ; ਕਰਿ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
The Lord who made the precious human body and fashioned it from clay
ਅਨਿਕ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਕੇ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਹ ॥੧॥
has hidden the countless faults within a person's mind, so that he still looks clean and pure. ॥1॥
ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨੈ ਤੇ; ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਹ ॥
The Lord who has such virtues should never be forgotten by our minds.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਜਿ. ਰਚੇ ਜਿ ਆਨ ਸਿਉ; ਸੋ ਰਲੀਐ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one who forsakes God's remembrance and becomes attached to other things mixes with the dust; his life goes to waste. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ; ਮਤ ਬਿਲਮ ਕਰੇਹ ॥
Remember Him, remember Him with every breath, at all times; take care not to delay at all.
ਛੋਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਪੰਚੁ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਹੁ; ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੨॥
Give up love of the world's perishable things and attachment to the visible world, and keep your love with the Lord. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਏਕ, ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਕੀਏ; ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਏਹ ॥
The One who from Himself made these many, many colours of the world is present everywhere now and will remain for ever.
ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੩॥
Taking teaching from the Guru, serve and worship that Transcendent Lord. ॥3॥
ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਵਡਾ; ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਰਨੇਹ ॥
That Lord is higher than the highest beings and greater than the great, yet He is said to dwell with all beings.
ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਸਰਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੪੭॥
Nanak, pray: O Lord, make me the humble servant of the servants of Your servants. ॥4॥17॥47॥
ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ; ਤਿਆਗੀ ਅਨ ਆਸ ॥
The Lord's devotees take the support of the one Lord alone and give up hope in other supports.
ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥
They are sure that God has power over all beings, is full of all powers, and is the treasure of all virtues. ॥1॥
ਜਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
The Lord's Name is the support of His servants' lives; they ever stay in the Lord's refuge.
ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ; ਸੰਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the minds of the saints there is ever the support of the Lord's Name alone. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਆਪਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਵਸੀ; ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ॥
The saints are sure that the Lord Himself protects every being, Himself gives every gift, and Himself sustains all.
813: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
The Lord is Merciful to the meek, the source of grace, and cares for every being with every breath. ॥2॥
ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ. ਜੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਸਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Whatever the all-powerful Lord is doing is for the good of beings.
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
The one whom the perfect Guru taught the true way of life became sure that comfort lies only in living in the Master's will. ॥3॥
ਚਿੰਤ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਗਣਤ ਤਜਿ; ਜਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Nanak: the Lord's servant has given up worldly worry, anxiety and calculation and has recognised the Lord's command as being for his good.
ਨਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ. ਨਹ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੪੮॥
The Lord's servant stays ever dyed in His love, sure that the Lord never dies and never deserts His servant. ॥4॥18॥48॥
ਮਹਾ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੇ. ਭਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ; ਪਰਸਤ ਪਾਪ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
Touching the feet of the saints, all sins flee, and the mind finds peace from the great burning of vice.
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤ ਥੇ; ਕਾਢੇ ਦੇ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
Those rotting in the pitch-dark well of vice and sin, the saints lift out, giving them their hand. ॥1॥
ਓਇ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ; ਹਮ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ॥
They are my true friends, and I am the dust of their feet,
ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੁਖੀ; ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
meeting whom my mind is filled with bliss; they give the gift of spiritual life. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਲੀਖਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅਬ ਆਇ ॥

O Lord, Nanak repeats Your Name day and night and is ever and ever a sacrifice to You. ॥4॥20॥50॥

My constant prayer is that whatever wish I make in my mind, I may receive from my Lord.
ਦੇਉ ਸੂਹਨੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ; ਬੀਜਨੁ ਢੋਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
May I sweep the floor and wave the fan in the Guru's house, the holy congregation. ॥1॥ Rahao

May I hear the Lord's life-giving virtues the saints speak in the congregation, and so make my mind drink the nectar of the Name.

In that relish may peace and contentment arise within me, and through it may I keep quenching the burning of vice. ॥2॥

When the saints sit in the congregation and worship the Lord, may I join them and sing His praises too.
ਕਰਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ; ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
May I bow before the saints and apply the dust of their feet to my forehead. ॥3॥

O God, this is Nanak's prayer at Your door: rising and sitting, may I ever repeat Your Name,

This world is an ocean surging with the water of vice; only the one who sings the Lord's praises crosses it,

the one who keeps company with the holy congregation; but only a fortunate one receives this gift. ॥1॥

The one who meets the perfect Guru, know for sure that comfort has entered his heart.

The one in the Guru's refuge is himself freed from Maya's bonds, his companions too cross the world-ocean, and he carries his family lines across.
ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੀ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
The service he did to the Guru proves fruitful, and he finds a place in the Lord's pure presence. ॥3॥

that the Lord has always honoured His servants and cut all their enemies to pieces. ॥3॥

that the Lord's servants stay in His refuge, and so no fear can touch them. ॥4॥26॥56॥

The Maya that will not stay with him to the end dwells in his mind, and he never forms kinship with the Transcendent Lord. ॥2॥
ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ; ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
O source of supreme light, perfect, all-pervading Lord, all beings are created by You.
ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ. ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
O unreachable, infinite God, as You keep me, so I live; You alone can save me from Maya's bonds. ॥3॥
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਦੇਹਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Nanak, say: O God, Creator of the world, able to do all, bless me with Your Name.
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੫੭॥
Dwelling in the holy congregation, ever sing the Lord's praises; so can one cross the world-ocean. ॥4॥27॥57॥
ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ. ਨਹੀ ਪਤਰਿਆ; ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
O mind, who has not been deceived by trusting you?
ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ; ਨਰਕ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
You stay caught in attachment to the great enchantress, Maya, and this path leads straight to hell. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਖੁਟਹਰ. ਤੇਰਾ, ਨਹੀ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ; ਤੂ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਮਾਦਾ ॥
O false mind, you cannot be trusted, for you stay greatly intoxicated with Maya.
ਖਰ ਕਾ ਪੈਖਰੁ ਤਉ ਛੁਟੈ; ਜਉ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਾਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
As a donkey's hind tether is loosed only when it has been loaded, so you too should not be given the chance to run wild. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਖੰਡੇ; ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਡਾਂਡ ॥
O mind, you break the rules of chanting, austerity and self-discipline, and so suffer the pains and punishments of Death.
ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ. ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ; ਨਿਰਲਜੇ ਭਾਂਡ ॥੨॥
O shameless clown, you do not remember the pains of the round of birth and death. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਮਹਾ ਮੀਤੁ; ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
O mind, the Lord is ever with you, your helper and great friend, yet a gap stands between you and Him.
ਬੀਧਾ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰਈ; ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਹਾ ਖੇਦੁ ॥੩॥
The five robbers, lust and the rest, hold you in their grip, and so great anguish stays within you. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਜਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Nanak: take the refuge of those saints who have brought their minds under control, to whom God has given this gift;
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੫੮॥
to such servants offer your body, your wealth and everything you have. ॥4॥28॥58॥
ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ. ਆਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Making the effort to repeat the Lord's Name, joy arises in the mind; remembering the Name, the highest comfort is found.
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Repeating the Lord's Name again and again, reflection on the virtues of the all-perfect Lord stays in the mind. ॥1॥
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਪਤ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
Meditating on the Guru's beautiful feet and repeating the Lord's Name, I receive spiritual life.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਤੇ; ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Worshipping the Transcendent Lord, I drink with my mouth the life-giving water of the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸੇ; ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲੋਚ ॥
Worshipping the Lord, all beings dwell in spiritual bliss, and a longing for remembrance arises in the minds of all who repeat the Name.
ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਚਿਤਵਤੇ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ॥੨॥
Those who repeat the Name ever think of doing good to others, and no sin or vice can touch them. ॥2॥
816: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਬਸੰਤ ਧੰਨੁ; ਜਹ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Blessed is the place, and blessed those who dwell there, where the Lord's Name is repeated,
ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਤਿ ਘਨਾ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
for where the Lord's discourse and praise abound, that place becomes the abode of spiritual bliss and poise. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
So never forget from the mind the Master of the masterless.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੫੯॥
Nanak, say: ever stay in the refuge of the Lord in whose hand is everything. ॥4॥29॥59॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ. ਬੰਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ; ਫੁਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
The Lord who kept you bound in your mother's womb, and then brought you out and settled you among the world's comforts,
ever remember His beautiful feet; so the mind stays ever calm. ॥1॥
ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਅਥਵਾ ਮੁਇਆ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
People stay attached to Maya, which is of no use to anyone, in life or in death.
ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ; ਕੋਊ. ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only a rare one forms love with the Lord who made this whole creation. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ. ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ; ਘਾਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
O mortal, the Creator Himself makes the heat of vice and the coolness of the Name, and He Himself draws one out of the burning of vice.
ਕੀਰੀ ਤੇ ਹਸਤੀ ਕਰੈ; ਟੂਟਾ ਲੇ ਗਾਢੈ ॥੨॥
He turns an ant into an elephant, the worthless into the honoured, and Himself takes hold of one broken off from His feet and joins him back; stay in His refuge. ॥2॥
ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਕਿਰਤਿ ॥
Beings born of eggs, of the womb, of sweat, and all vegetation: all this is the creation made by the Lord.
ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ; ਰਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ॥੩॥
Remember the Lord's Name while staying detached from this creation; by this practice all of life's aims are fulfilled. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਹੋਵਨਾ; ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧ ॥
O God, we beings can do nothing; keep us in the Guru's refuge.
ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਕੂਪ ਅੰਧ ਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਢ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੦॥
Nanak, pray: O Guru, we are drowned in attachment to Maya; draw us out of this dark well. ॥4॥30॥60॥
ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਾ; ਖੋਜਉ ਬਨ ਥਾਨ ॥
Searching and searching for the Lord I wander everywhere, combing many forests and places.
ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਐਸੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
Yet I do not find Him; I have heard the Lord God is such that Maya cannot deceive Him, He is imperishable, and His secret cannot be known. ॥1॥
ਕਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ; ਆਤਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
My constant longing is: when shall I behold my Lord with my soul's delight?
ਜਾਗਨ ਤੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ; ਬਸੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If one could dwell with the Lord even in a dream while asleep, that dream is better than this waking. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਬਰਨ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਉ; ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
To behold the Lord I perform the duties of the four castes and four stages of life and hear the Shastras, yet His sight does not come, and my thirst for it remains.
ਰੂਪੁ ਨ. ਰੇਖ ਨ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੨॥
The imperishable Lord has no form or feature, nor is He made of the five elements as beings are. ॥2॥
ਓਹੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਹਹਿ; ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ॥
Only rare great yogis, those saints, describe that form of His, that He has no form or feature.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੇ; ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਤੇ. ਈਸੁਰ ॥੩॥
Those whom the Lord in His grace Himself meets are the great yogis; they are truly blessed. ॥3॥
ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰੇ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤਹ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Rare saints see that He dwells within all beings and is also apart from all; joined to His feet, all doubts are destroyed.
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੧॥
Nanak: the one whose full fortune awakens, the Lord Himself meets. ॥4॥31॥61॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ; ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Those beings are delighted, beholding the Lord's manifest glory,
ਕਰਜੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ; ਕਰਿ ਆਹਰੁ ਆਪ ॥੧॥
from whose heads the Guru, by his own effort and the gift of his Word, lifted the debt of vices from past lives. ॥1॥
ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ. ਨਿਬਹਤ ਰਹੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੂਟ ॥
The Guru's Word is a food for spiritual life that never runs out; the one whose life passes in eating it himself and sharing it with others
ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸਮਗਰੀ; ਕਬਹੂ. ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
has his storehouses of this provision ever full, and it never runs short. ॥1॥ Rahao
So, dwelling in the Guru's company, remember the Lord's Name; it is a treasure that never ends.
ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ; ਦੇਤੇ. ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੨॥
To the one who remembers the Name, the Lord does not delay in giving righteousness, wealth, desire and liberation, the four renowned things. ॥2॥
ਭਗਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
The devotees of the Lord of the universe, the Sustainer, remember His Name, abiding in unbroken love.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ; ਜਾ ਕਾ. ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
They gather so much of the wealth of the Lord's Name that it cannot be reckoned. ॥3॥
ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
O Lord, by Your grace Your devotees stay in Your refuge and keep praising Your greatness.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਅੰਤੁ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੬੨॥
Nanak: the virtues of the Master of the world are infinite; their end cannot be found. ॥4॥32॥62॥
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਕਾਰਜ ਭਏ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
In the holy congregation, remembering the all-perfect Lord again and again, all one's affairs succeed.
ਕਰਤਾਰ ਪੁਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਸੈ; ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Creator Himself dwells in the Creator's city, the holy congregation, close by His saints. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗਤਾ; ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Those who come to the congregation and pray at the Guru's door meet no obstacle on life's path.
ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ; ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
The Sovereign Lord is ever the protector of His saints, and His Name is their capital. ॥1॥
817: ਤੋਟਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਮੂਲਿ; ਪੂਰਨ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
The holy congregation is a place where the storehouses of blessings are ever full, and there they never run short at all.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
The one who dwells there has the beautiful feet of the unreachable, infinite Lord abiding in mind and heart. ॥2॥
ਬਸਤ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ; ਕਿਛੁ ਊਨ. ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
All who dwell in the congregation and practise remembrance of the Name live in comfort and see no lack of anything.
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥੩॥
By the Guru's grace they meet the perfect Lord, Master of the world. ॥3॥
ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਰਹਿ; ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
All people acclaim those who dwell in the congregation; the holy congregation is a beautiful place that lasts for ever.
ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ; ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੬੩॥
Nanak: by the congregation's blessing, repeating the Lord's Name, the treasure of all comforts, one attains lasting union with the perfect Guru. ॥4॥33॥63॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਹੋਈਐ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
Ever remember the Lord's Name; through remembrance one is freed of diseases such as the vices.
ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਕੀ ਲਸਟਿਕਾ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਮਾਰਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This remembrance is the staff of Ramchandra, before which no wicked one could raise his head; it has driven out every disease from those who remember. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ; ਨਿਤ ਕੀਚੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
Taking the perfect Guru's refuge, repeat God's Name; so spiritual bliss can be ever enjoyed.
Be a sacrifice to the Guru's company; through it the chance of union with the Lord comes about. ॥1॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
remembering whom spiritual bliss is gained and separation from the Lord is removed.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥੩੪॥੬੪॥
Nanak: stay in the refuge of the Lord who is able to create the world. ॥2॥34॥64॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ; ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
The one who held to the Guru alone gave up every other remedy and took the Lord's Name as medicine;
ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਰੋਗ; ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
all his fevers, sins and diseases were wiped away, and his mind, saved from the heat of vice, became cool. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ; ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
The one who keeps the perfect Guru enshrined in his heart has all pain removed,
ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for the Lord, able to protect, has shown him grace and protected him. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿਆ; ਕੀਨਾ ਅਪਨਇਆ ॥
The Lord has taken him by the arm, drawn him out and made him His own.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੁਖੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੬੫॥
Nanak: remembering the Lord again and again, his mind and heart are in bliss and no fear remains. ॥2॥1॥65॥
ਕਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ. ਥਾਪਿਆ; ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨਿ ॥
The Lord places His hand on His devotees' foreheads, blesses them, and gives them His Name as a gift.
ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ; ਤਾ ਕੀ. ਨਹੀ ਹਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
Service and devotion to the Transcendent Lord fulfil life's purpose; they never go to waste. ॥1॥
ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖਤਾ; ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਨਿ ॥
The Lord Himself preserves the honour of His devotees.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ; ਸੋ ਲੇਤਾ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever His devotees resolve in their minds, the Lord accepts. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ; ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
The saints who take the support of the Lord's beautiful feet become as dear to Him as life.
ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੬॥
Nanak: abiding in poise and love, those saints meet the Lord, and their souls merge in His Light. ॥2॥2॥66॥
ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ; ਦੀਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Those servants to whom God Himself has given the support of His beautiful feet in the holy congregation
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਪਰੇ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
stay in His refuge, beholding His everlasting glory. ॥1॥
ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
God is infinite and able to protect; service and devotion to Him, done in the congregation, make life pure.
ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜ. ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਿ; ਕੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru has established the spiritual kingdom of the Lord in the city of Ramdas, the holy congregation. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Dwelling in the congregation, ever meditate on the Lord; then no obstacle arises on life's path.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਭਇ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੩॥੬੭॥
Nanak: praise the Lord's Name; in fear of the Lord all enemies, lust and the rest, flee. ॥2॥3॥67॥
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਮਾਗੈ ॥
Joining the holy congregation, worship the Lord with mind and heart.
ਉਚਰਤ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ; ਦੂਰ ਤੇ. ਜਮੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
Uttering the virtues and praise of the Sustainer of the world, even Death flees from afar. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
The person who repeats the Lord's Name stays ever awake against the vices.
818: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ. ਨਹ ਜੋਹਈ; ਤਿਤੁ ਚਾਖੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
No spell or charm can affect him, and no evil eye can touch him. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਅਨਰਾਗੈ ॥
Lust, anger, the intoxication of pride, attachment and cravings for other things are all destroyed within him.
ਆਨੰਦ ਮਗਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੪॥੬੮॥
Nanak: the one who abides in the relish of the Lord's Name, absorbed in His love and staying in His refuge, is ever immersed in spiritual bliss. ॥2॥4॥68॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੈ; ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Our way of life is in the Lord's power; whatever He prompts us to do, that alone we can do.
ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ; ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ. ਨਹੀ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
The one on whom the Sovereign Sustainer of the world is pleased need fear nothing. ॥1॥
ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ, ਕਦੇ ਤੁਧੁ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
O dear Sikh of the Guru, keep the Transcendent Lord in your mind, and no pain will ever touch you;
ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
let alone pain, even Death's messenger will not come near you. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
The Lord alone has the power to create the world; there is no other with such power.
ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥੫॥੬੯॥
Nanak: we beings can stay only in that Lord's refuge; His everlasting support is the strength of our minds. ॥2॥5॥69॥
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ; ਨਾਠਾ ਦੁਖ ਠਾਉ ॥
Remembering my Lord again and again, the very abode of pain has fled from within me.
ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਪਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਧਾਉ ॥੧॥
Joining the Guru's company I have found rest at the Lord's feet, and so I never run from it again. ॥1॥
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਨੇ; ਚਰਨਨੑ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am a sacrifice to his feet.
ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਨੇ; ਪੇਖਤ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Beholding the Guru I sing the Lord's praises, and all bliss, comfort and joy stay within me. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ; ਇਹੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace the Lord's discourse, His praise in song, and the deep longing for His praise have become my life's aim.
ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ; ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥੬॥੭੦॥
Nanak, say: by the Guru's grace the Lord is well pleased with me, and I now receive the fruit my heart desires. ॥2॥6॥70॥
ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਰਿਦ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
O Lord, this is Your servant's prayer: let the light of spiritual life shine in my heart,
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਦੋਖਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
that, O Transcendent Lord, by Your grace the vices may be destroyed within me. ॥1॥
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
O all-pervading God, You are the treasure of all virtues; I have the support of Your beautiful feet alone.
ਕੀਰਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਉ; ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Have mercy, that as long as breath is in my body I may keep remembering Your Name and singing Your praise. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੰਧਪ ਤੂਹੈ; ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
O God, You alone are my mother, father and kin; You dwell in all beings.
ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੭੧॥
Nanak: stay in the refuge of the Lord whose praise makes life pure. ॥2॥7॥71॥
ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ. ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ; ਸਭਿ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
Ever praise the Lord, Master of all powers; all people wish well to the one who praises Him.
ਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹਹਿ; ਸੁਣਿ ਦਾਸ ਮਿਲਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
With their mouths they call him a devoted one, and hearing his words, they fall at his feet as servants. ॥1॥
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰਸ; ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੑ ॥
The one to whom the perfect Guru has given the comfort, bliss and relish of spiritual poise
ਜੀਅ ਸਗਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੀਨੑ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ever keeps kinship with the Lord's Name and, knowing Him to pervade all, stays kind to all beings. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥
Such people are sure that the unfathomable Lord, Master of all virtues, pervades all beings.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਗਤ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੈ; ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਧੀਰ ॥੨॥੮॥੭੨॥
Nanak: the devotees who praise Him, seeing His support, stay ever full of bliss. ॥2॥8॥72॥
ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ. ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ; ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
The servant whose prayer God, the Giver, has heard, and on whom He has become merciful,
ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ; ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
that servant God has ever protected, and ashes have fallen on the face of his slanderer. ॥1॥
ਤੁਝਹਿ. ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਕੋ, ਮੀਤ ਜਨ; ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸ ॥
O friend, if you stay the Guru's servant, no one can cast an evil eye on you;
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਦੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
be sure the Transcendent Lord, giving His own hand, will ever protect you. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਬੀਆ. ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
The Lord alone is the Giver to all beings; there is no other; stay in His refuge.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ; ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥੯॥੭੩॥
Nanak's prayer too is ever at His door: O Lord, Yours is my only strength. ॥2॥9॥73॥
O my friends, my dear ones, be sure the Lord protects His servants.
ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ; ਤੁਮੑ ਹੋਹੁ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The slanderers of His servants die a spiritual death of their own; so take the Lord's support and be free of worry about them. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਏ; ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
The one who by good fortune met the Guru has had all his wishes fulfilled by the Lord.
819: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ; ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
The Lord whose service fulfils every wish also brings that servant acclaim throughout the world. ॥1॥
ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਨਤ ਹਰਿ; ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
The Lord who is highest, infinite, whose virtues cannot be counted, in whose hand are all beings,
ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੭੪॥
Nanak, stay in His refuge, and be sure He is with me everywhere. ॥2॥10॥74॥
The one who keeps the perfect Guru enshrined in his heart, on whom the Guru is merciful,
ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਆ; ਤੂਟੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
to whom the Guru has shown the true path of life, has all Death's nooses broken: the bonds of the mind that bring spiritual death. ॥1॥
ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸੰਸਾ ਮਿਟਿਆ; ਗਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
Singing the Lord's Name, all pain, hunger and dread are wiped away.
ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Name come the comfort, bliss and relish of spiritual poise, and all needs are fulfilled. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ; ਰਾਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪ ॥
The one who remembered the Lord's Name the Lord Himself protected; the burning of vice within him was quenched, and his mind became cool.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੭੫॥
Nanak, you too stay in the refuge of the Lord of such great power. ॥2॥11॥75॥
ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਫਲ ਥਾਨੁ; ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
The body of that person becomes beautiful, his heart becomes the place where life's purpose is fulfilled, and all his affairs are accomplished,
ਭਉ ਨਾਠਾ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ; ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
who, dwelling in the holy congregation, ever remembers the Lord's Name; every fear leaves him and wandering ends. ॥1॥
ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Dwelling in the company of the Guru's devoted ones, one gains the bliss of spiritual poise and the mind finds peace.
ਸਾਈ ਘੜੀ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Blessed is that moment in a person's life when, in the company of the devoted, he remembers the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ; ਫਿਰਤੇ ਪਹਨਾਮ ॥
Those whom no one knew before become renowned in the world through remembrance in the holy congregation.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਘਟ ਘਟ ਸਭ ਜਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੭੬॥
Nanak: taking the support of the holy congregation, ever stay in the refuge of the Lord who knows every thought of every heart. ॥2॥12॥76॥
ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ; ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
God Himself has removed my dear one's disease, and by His grace comfort and peace have come.
ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
That Lord of great glory and wondrous form has Himself shown me grace. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ; ਰਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
See His kindness: the Guru, the Lord Himself, has shown me grace and saved my dear one.
ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਜੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have taken the support of that Lord alone, who is ever the helper. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਬਿਰਥੀ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Stay servants of the Lord's door alone; a servant's prayer never goes in vain, for the Lord surely helps and Himself saves from disease.
ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੭੭॥
Nanak, say: that Lord is the treasure of all virtues, full of every virtue; I have the support of that Lord alone. ॥2॥13॥77॥
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ; ਜਿਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Those who forget the Giver of life bring on spiritual death and stay in the round of birth and death.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
But the Lord's servant has remembered the Transcendent Lord at all times and stays dyed in His love. ॥1॥
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਨਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਆਸ ॥
Peace, spiritual poise and great bliss stay in the servant's heart, and every wish of his is fulfilled.
ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The servant has found spiritual bliss by remembering the Lord, the treasure of virtues, in the holy congregation. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜਨ; ਤੁਮੑ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
O Master, You know every heart; You ever hear Your servant's prayer.
ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੭੮॥
O Master of Nanak, You pervade every place. ॥2॥14॥78॥
ਤਾਤੀ ਵਾਉ. ਨ ਲਗਈ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
In the refuge of the Transcendent Lord not even a hot wind of affliction touches one.
ਚਉਗਿਰਦ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਾਰ; ਦੁਖੁ. ਲਗੈ ਨ, ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
The Lord's Name is, as it were, a protective line drawn all around us; through it no pain can touch us. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
The one who meets the perfect Guru, who has made the plan to cure beings' diseases with the medicine of the Name,
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਦੀਆ; ਏਕਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
to him the perfect Guru gives the medicine of the Lord's Name, and he keeps his attention ever fixed on the One Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਖਨਹਾਰਿ; ਸਭ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
The one who met the Guru was saved by the Lord, the Protector, who removed every disease within him.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੭੯॥
Nanak says: the Lord's grace came upon him, and the Lord became his helper. ॥2॥15॥79॥
ਅਪਣੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
The Transcendent Lord, the greatest God, has Himself ever protected His children, we beings.
ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਭਏ; ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Within those who take His refuge, peace and the comfort and bliss of poise arise, and their labour of service and remembrance bears fruit. ॥1॥ Rahao
820: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਸੁਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
That Lord has ever heard the prayer of His devotees Himself,
ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਅਨੁ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
He of the greatest glory; He removed their disease and blessed them with spiritual life. ॥1॥
ਦੋਖ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਬਖਸਿਅਨੁ; ਅਪਣੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
The Father-Lord has ever forgiven the faults of us, His children, and filled us with the strength of His Name.
ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਦਿਤਿਅਨੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੮੦॥
Nanak: the Father-Lord has ever given us, His children, the fruits our minds wished for; be ever a sacrifice to that Lord. ॥2॥16॥80॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
Bilaval · Chaupade Dupade · Guru Arjan · Ghar 6
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਹਨ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਇਹ. ਨ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
O my Enchanter, let me not hear with my ears such words that turn one away from the Lord:
ਸਾਕਤ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ. ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਤ; ਬੋਲਤ ਬੋਲ. ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the songs, tunes and melodies sung by those cut off from the Lord, which are worthless for spiritual life. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਉ; ਸਦਾ ਕਰਉ ਕਿਰਤਾਏ ॥
May I ever and at all times stay in the Guru's refuge, and ever do this work alone.
ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਤੇ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
O all-pervading Giver, O Lord, be merciful, that joining the Guru's congregation and singing Your praises I may receive from Your door the gift of fearlessness. ॥1॥
ਰਸਨਾ ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹ ਗੁਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
May my eyes enjoy the bliss of Your sight, and my tongue stay dyed in the virtues of You, the unreachable.
ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ; ਮੋਹਿ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੨॥
O Destroyer of the pain of the meek, be merciful to me and keep Your feet enshrined in my heart. ॥2॥
ਸਭਹੂ ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ; ਏਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਏ ॥
O Enchanter, give my sight such light that I see myself as lower than all and all as higher than me.
ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ, ਖੋਈ ਹਉ; ਮੋ ਕਉ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੩॥
O Enchanter, make the Guru's teaching firm in my heart, that I may remove pride from within me for ever. ॥3॥
ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ. ਨਹ ਤੁਲੀਐ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਏ ॥
O Enchanter, You are beyond weighing, beyond weighing, beyond weighing; Your greatness cannot be weighed; You love devotion and are merciful to all.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ; ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੧॥
Nanak: by the Enchanter-Lord's grace, whoever takes the Guru's refuge receives the gift of fearlessness and ever enjoys spiritual bliss. ॥4॥1॥81॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ; ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ ॥
O God, You alone are the support of my life.
ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ; ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਜਾਉ ਬਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O God, before You alone I bow, prostrating myself full length; again and again I am a sacrifice to You. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੈ ॥
O God, rising, sitting, sleeping and waking, this mind of mine keeps remembering You at all times.
ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ; ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
This mind lays its joys, its sorrows and its every pain before You alone. ॥1॥
ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ. ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ; ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ॥
O God, You alone are my shelter, my strength, my wisdom and my wealth; You alone are my family.
ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ. ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹਮਰੈ; ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖ ਚਰਨਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੮੨॥
Nanak, say: O God, whatever You do is good for me; beholding Your feet I find spiritual bliss. ॥2॥2॥82॥
O God, it is heard of You that You save all beings from vice,
ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਐਸੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
even those who keep company with sinners drowned in attachment and carelessly keep You forgotten. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸੰਚਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੇ, ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜੁ ਕੀਨੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਨ ॥
O God, Your beings gather Maya and hold it fit to grasp, but throw the life-giving water of Your Name out of their minds.
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ॥੧॥
They stay absorbed in lust, anger, greed and slander and tear virtues like service and contentment to shreds; be merciful and save them from vice. ॥1॥
ਇਨ ਤੇ. ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰਨ ॥
O my Master, draw us out of these vices; we cannot stand against them, and defeated, we have come to Your refuge.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਕ ਤਾਰਨ ॥੨॥੩॥੮੩॥
O God, this is Nanak's prayer to You: You carry across even those utterly empty of spiritual life, bringing them into the holy congregation. ॥2॥3॥83॥
ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
In the company of the saints, discourse on the Lord's praise is ever heard.
ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ, ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਧੁਨਿ; ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ. ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
There day and night His discourse and praise in song go on, and a current that stirs spiritual bliss and joy ever flows. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ; ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
The Lord in His mercy has made the saints His own servants and blessed them with the gift of His Name.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ; ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤ ॥੧॥
Singing the Lord's praises at all hours, lust, anger and the other vices leave their bodies. ॥1॥
